title: Finycs – Cloud Accounting Platform
description: Comprehensive cloud accounting platform with real-time financial reporting, automated GST compliance, multi-tenant data isolation, and invoice management.
details: Architected a full-stack, multi-tenant cloud accounting system engineered to support concurrent enterprise clients while ensuring rigorous data isolation.
Developed and scaled cross-platform web and mobile (React Native) architectures providing flawless multi-device synchronization.
Delivered interactive, real-time financial dashboards mapping Profit & Loss (P&L), dynamic cash flows, operating expenses, and tax summaries via Chart.js and Highcharts.js.
Built a custom Query Builder / KPI Tool allowing corporate clients to programmatically define custom performance metrics (e.g., Revenue = Sales - Expense).
Engineered complete, localized GST compliance modules capable of handling automated invoicing, E-Invoice setups, IRN generation, and E-Way Bill provisioning.
Integrated end-to-end user subscription workflows bound with tax-inclusive pricing matrices and secure PayU gateway pipelines.
Optimized backend REST APIs and frontend state routing to realize a ~40% net improvement in application performance and reporting efficiencies.

title: WMS / TMS / AMS / OMS – Enterprise Logistics Suite
description: Full-suite enterprise logistics platform covering Warehouse, Transport, Attendance, and Order Management for Radhakrishna Foodland Pvt. Ltd.
details: Architected and delivered the Warehouse Management System (WMS) with bin-level putaway, picking, packing, and GRN workflows across multiple warehouse locations.
Built the Transport Management System (TMS) enabling end-to-end trip planning, driver assignment, route tracking, and delivery reconciliation.
Developed the Attendance Management System (AMS) supporting multi-location employee check-ins, shift scheduling, leave workflows, and compliance reporting.
Engineered the Order Management System (OMS) handling inbound/outbound order lifecycle, stock reservations, and fulfillment pipelines.
Designed scalable REST APIs using Django and FastAPI, consumed by cross-functional operations teams and external integrations.
Implemented real-time notification pipelines via Firebase FCM for operational alerts and status updates.

title: Foundation AI – Customizable Analytics Dashboard
description: Customizable drag-and-drop analytics dashboard engine with modular widgets, dynamic layouts, and real-time visualization components.
details: Analytics Engine: Designed and shipped an enterprise-scale, drag-and-drop dashboard engine driven by react-grid-layout, empowering clients to customize layouts and personalize workspace metrics.
Table Extraction & Review Interface: Built a heavy-duty, multi-tabbed table processing dashboard supporting cell-level data validation, row/column injections, and structural header mapping.

Layout Persistence: Synchronized localized user configurations with persistent Node.js/Django backend structures, introducing custom confidence-based highlighting and automated validation thresholds for document reviews.
Decoupled Architecture: Refactored the UI hierarchy to optimize component isolation, creating a highly modular visual library that successfully improved enterprise client adoption.
Testing Rigor: Implemented strict automated validation suites via Jest and Enzyme to guarantee interface consistency and drop regression defects.

title: Get It Done – HRMS & Task Management System
description: Full-fledged task tracking and human resource management platform featuring real-time push alerts and performance trend charts.
details: Developed an end-to-end Human Resource Management System (HRMS) featuring agile Kanban task boards, employee review workflows, and gamified performance reward modules.
Integrated Firebase database pipelines to deliver real-time data synchronization, secure user authentication, and lightweight server infrastructure.
Structured instant push notification logic for assigning tasks, tracking critical project deadlines, and facilitating management approval matrices.
Built out specialized management dashboards tracking workforce output distributions, historical productivity charts, and quick-export operational data sheets.

title: Inventory Management & Desktop Bridge App
description: Cross-platform desktop inventory bridge app connecting localized React interfaces with native OS filesystems and Tally ERP systems.
details: Engineered a cross-platform desktop application leveraging Tauri (Rust) to bridge a web-based React frontend with native OS capabilities, enabling offline-capable execution paths.
Expanded the core Finycs 'Items' module into a fully standalone desktop inventory suite equipped with advanced multi-tier filtering, structural categorization, and automated bulk item operations.
Created a real-time Bridge App designed to map and sync local Tally ERP records directly onto the Finycs cloud infrastructure.
Mitigated communication overhead by utilizing highly optimized API endpoints and state reconciliation algorithms, reducing data sync latency by ~35%.

title: Indian Constitution and Polity
description: Mobile app for exploring Indian Constitution with knowledge graph interface, personal note-taking, and offline SQLite storage.
details: Designed and built a mobile knowledge graph interface focused on mapping structural constitutional hierarchies for seamless educational exploration.
Programmed client-facing interaction utilities, including rich-text document highlighting, flexible bookmarking, personal note-taking spaces, and community commentary forums.
Configured real-time external data feeds mapping contemporary political news and current affairs.
Crafted a localized database architecture inside SQLite to accommodate comprehensive offline operation coupled with Text-to-Speech (TTS) narration features.

title: Finalyze – Financial Analysis Platform
description: Financial analysis platform with interactive dashboards, corporate ratio evaluation, and multi-period comparisons.
details: Built dedicated financial analytics interfaces that map complex balance sheets, detailed P&L trajectories, and automated corporate ratio evaluations.
Programmed interactive multi-period performance comparisons and granular multi-variable data filters via Chart.js and Highcharts.js dashboards.
Successfully minimized standard business auditing and reporting overhead by 60% via real-time interactive charting spaces.

title: Vintale UI – Figma-to-Code Frontend
description: Pixel-perfect, responsive frontend application built from a Figma prototype using Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, and GSAP animations.
details: Implemented a pixel-perfect, fully responsive interface directly from a Figma design prototype, matching all layout specifications and breakpoints.
Integrated GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) for smooth, prototype-matching animations — managing animation context via a custom useGSAP hook.
Built a modular component library (Header, Hero, Features, AnimatedSection) using TypeScript interfaces and Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes.
Deployed to Vercel with production-optimized build settings, ensuring fast load times and SEO-friendly HTML structure.

title: Interactive Model Analysis Workbench
description: Jupyter-like interactive notebook platform for data scientists — create, manage, and run notebooks with real-time code execution and drag-and-drop cell management.
details: Built a high-fidelity Jupyter-inspired notebook interface enabling data scientists to create, delete, and switch between multiple notebooks seamlessly.
Implemented real-time code execution with streaming output via Socket.io WebSocket integration with a Jupyter backend.
Engineered drag-and-drop cell reordering using react-beautiful-dnd and virtualized cell rendering via react-window for performance with large notebooks.
Integrated Monaco Editor (VS Code's editor engine) for code cells with full syntax highlighting and TypeScript-powered type safety throughout.

title: LLM Monitoring Dashboard
description: Real-time monitoring dashboard for Large Language Model (LLM) performance metrics, token usage, latency tracking, and API call analytics.
details: Designed and built a real-time monitoring interface for LLM API performance, tracking key metrics like token usage, response latency, and request throughput.
Implemented interactive charts and data visualizations to surface model performance trends and usage patterns over time.
Architected a clean, reusable component structure using React and TypeScript for maintainability and extensibility.

title: Cake Ordering App
description: Full-featured cake ordering web application with product catalog, cart management, and order flow built with Next.js App Router.
details: Built a modern e-commerce ordering experience for a cake shop using Next.js App Router with server-side rendering and client-side interactivity.
Implemented product catalog browsing, customization options, cart management, and a multi-step checkout order flow.
Leveraged Next.js font optimization with Geist font family for fast, visually consistent rendering across devices.

title: Dragon Repeller – Browser RPG Game
description: Mini text-based RPG game built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Fight monsters, earn gold, buy weapons, and defeat the dragon!
details: Designed and implemented a complete game loop with state management — tracking player health, gold, XP, and equipped weapons in vanilla JavaScript.
Built a branching encounter system with multiple monster types, each with unique health and attack values, culminating in a final dragon boss fight.
Deployed as a static GitHub Pages site for instant browser-based play with no dependencies or build tools required.
